successCriteria.description: LeaveService implements ILeaveService with submit/approve/reject/cancel operations, each returning the updated LeaveRequest.
Each operation computes the day count n via the shared countLeaveDays helper exactly once — no inline re-derivation of endDate - startDate + 1 anywhere in the service.

approve enforces sufficiency (n > availableDays throws InsufficientBalanceError) and overlap (findApprovedOverlapping returns any intersecting APPROVED request for the same employee regardless of leave type → OverlapError) in the same place.
The balance year is derived once from startDate.getFullYear() per operation (binding rule 4 — a request crossing 31 Dec is charged in full to its startDate's year, never split).
Every status change + balance counter change + audit write runs through the SAME unit-of-work client in ONE transaction (client passed through to balance and audit services).
src/app.ts registers the leave routes alongside uptimeRoutes so the leave HTTP surface is reachable.

constraints: The SERVICE owns the unit of work: it takes an injected IUnitOfWork with withTransaction(fn) and never imports a pool, a client, or a module-level db helper. Do NOT put withTransaction on a repository. Participating repository/service methods take the client as an optional LAST parameter and fall back to the shared pool when omitted (AGENTS.md rule 5).
Negative guards live ONLY in BalanceService — the leave service must not duplicate counter-below-zero checks; it only enforces sufficiency (n <= availableDays) and overlap at approval.
Cross-module dependencies (balance, audit, notification, employee, leave-type, policy) are imported only through each module's public entry point (index.ts barrel), never from internals.
No unit/integration tests are created in this sub-phase — they are owned by Phase 4c and must not gate this sub-phase.
outOfScope: src/modules/leave/leave.model.ts and leave.repository.ts (LeaveRequest entity, ILeaveRequestRepository, PgLeaveRequestRepository, countLeaveDays) — owned by Phase 4a.

entityInvariants.invariant: Lifecycle: SUBMITTED → APPROVED | REJECTED | CANCELLED. approve/reject only accept a SUBMITTED request; cancel only accepts SUBMITTED or APPROVED. Each transition records the acting actor (approvedBy/rejectedBy/cancelledBy) and timestamp.

Counters are mutated only through BalanceService: SUBMIT reserves pendingDays += n; APPROVE moves pendingDays -= n, usedDays += n; REJECT/CANCEL(PENDING) release pendingDays -= n; CANCEL(APPROVED) restores usedDays -= n. No counter goes negative (throws, never clamps).

Every state-changing operation (submit/approve/reject/cancel) writes exactly one audit record with the matching action (SUBMIT/APPROVE/REJECT/CANCEL) in the same transaction as the status and balance changes.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: employee only; actorId must equal the request employeeId
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: ValidationError on invalid/missing dates or leaveTypeId; NotFoundError on missing employee/leave type/active policy; InsufficientBalanceError on reserve failure
ValidationError if not SUBMITTED; InsufficientBalanceError if n > availableDays; OverlapError on intersecting APPROVED request; NotFoundError on missing request/balance
ValidationError if not SUBMITTED or rejectionReason empty; NotFoundError on missing request/balance
ValidationError if not SUBMITTED/APPROVED; AuthorizationError if non-owner non-hr_admin; NotFoundError on missing request/balance

consistencyRequirements.requirement: Day count must reuse the single shared countLeaveDays helper (endDate - startDate + 1, inclusive, no weekend/holiday exclusion) — never re-derived inline.
Balance counter transitions and negative guards must match BalanceService's reserve/approve/reject/cancel semantics (availableDays = entitlementDays - usedDays - pendingDays, derived never stored).
Audit writes must go through AuditService.record with the AuditAction union (SUBMIT/APPROVE/REJECT/CANCEL) and performedAt set at write time.
Notifications must go through NotificationService.notify, honoring the both-or-null relatedEntityType/relatedEntityId invariant.
Transaction boundary must follow AGENTS.md rule 5: service owns the unit of work via an injected IUnitOfWork.withTransaction(fn); it must not import the pool or issue BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK inline.

Error responses must use the AppError contract ({ error, code } via toResponse) with statusCode mapping: 400 validation, 401 auth, 403 authorization, 404 not found, 422 insufficient balance/policy violation.

integrationPoints.why: reserve/approve/reject/cancel counter transitions and getAvailableDays sufficiency derivation
record an audit entry for every state change in the same transaction
register leaveRoutes so the HTTP surface is mounted
